description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) as a function of the number of queries used during inference for different configurations of Dense Retrieval (DPR) with and without query expansion. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is linear, ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and ranges from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick labels at every 0.5 interval. The plot includes four lines representing different DPR configurations: "DPR w/o query" is depicted with a black line and no markers, "DPR w/ corpus expansion" is shown with a red line and circle markers, "DPR w/ document expansion" is represented by a green line with triangle markers, and "DPR w/ document expansion" is indicated by a blue line with star markers. The black line remains relatively flat, starting just above 35.0 and ending just below 35.5. The red line starts at approximately 35.5, peaks at around 36.0 between 2 and 3 queries, and then gradually declines to just above 35.0 by the 10th query. The green line starts just below 35.0, peaks at around 35.5 between 2 and 3 queries, and then declines to just above 34.5 by the 10th query. The blue line starts at approximately 34.5, peaks at around 35.0 between 2 and 3 queries, and then declines to just above 34.0 by the 10th query.
